dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You have a sharp mind for business.

dialogues.speaker: Pakaa Nui
dialogues.text: Haha, well, a store whose objective is to do its utmost to satisfy the customer's needs can't do too badly, right?

dialogues.speaker: Pakaa Nui
dialogues.text: I haven't been in business for long, of course — just talking generally about my experience in the art of Mora-making.
